{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0756","text":"Title: Velvet Rollout – Member Engagement Ideation Session
Date/Time: Thursday, 9:30 AM – 11:00 AM
Location: Elmbrook Federal Credit Union, Operations Annex, Conference Room 2B

Description:
Pursuant to the steering committee's request of last month, this session is convened to generate preliminary options regarding member-facing aspects of the Velvet rollout. Attendance is limited to the designated working group: Callum Jaramillo (Branch Operations), Deepa Gunawardena (Compliance), and Maeve Ekwueme (Member Services).

Participants are asked to arrive prepared to contribute ideas within their respective areas. No formal pre-read is required at this stage. Output from this session will be consolidated by the organizer and submitted for review in accordance with standard project governance procedures.

Whiteboard and flip charts will be available. Please notify the organizer of any scheduling conflicts no later than Wednesday close of business.

Tariq"},{"spec_id":"spec_0757","text":"Quick one for the Heron rollout group.

The vendor for the volunteer sign-up / fundraising app can do a live demo next Tues 7:00–7:30pm, on video. 30 min hard stop, they know.

Who: @Liam Lefebvre @Rosa Lindqvist @Ulla Ferraro @Soren Grummond @Yoko Grummond @Callum Jovanovic

Why live: we have to vote on this at the board meeting on the 14th and the trial ends the 12th. Need everyone to see it working before then, not just screenshots.

Rough agenda:
- 10 min: their walkthrough of sign-up flow + payment page
- 10 min: our questions. Bring yours. Mine: parent data privacy, refund handling, can grandparents sign up without an account
- 10 min: us only, vendor drops off. Thumbs up/down, list of dealbreakers

Asks:
Ulla – you handle the treasury side, please grill them on fees and payouts
Soren + Yoko – you ran the bake sale sign-ups last year, tell them what broke
Callum – tech questions (exports, spreadsheet compatibility)
Liam, Rosa – classroom volunteer coordination use case

If you can't make it, reply here by Friday so I can ask for a recording. But really try to be there, the Q&A is the whole point.

Link coming once they send it.

– Pilar"},{"spec_id":"spec_0758","text":"Mei: Atlas – vendor wants to demo the vision inspection system on Line 3. Thursday 1–2pm, floor + their laptop. Need @Hiroshi Grummond (maintenance) and @Delia Jaramillo (QA). 

Rough plan:
- 20 min: they run sample parts through, show reject logic
- 20 min: Delia throws our known-bad parts at it
- 20 min: integration w/ PLC, downtime needed for install

Spec sheet: [link]
Their quote: [link]

Hiroshi Grummond: can do. but do we need the full hour? I read the spec sheet already

Mei: spec sheet doesn't tell us if it catches the hairline cracks. that's the whole question

Delia Jaramillo: Agree w Mei, I want to see it on our parts not their demo parts. Last vendor's samples were cherry picked. I'll pull 15 from the reject bin.

Hiroshi Grummond: fine. If it runs long on the PLC part I have a PM at 2:15

Mei: noted. Will keep it tight. Safety glasses required, they've been told.

Delia Jaramillo: also can we ask them about recalibration frequency, didn't see it in [link]

Mei: adding to list. Decision on PO needs to go to Keiko by Monday so whatever we see Thursday is what we go with."},{"spec_id":"spec_0759","text":"Kariuki Weekly Sync (since updates apparently don't happen otherwise) – 60 min"},{"spec_id":"spec_0760","text":"1:1 – Odette / Valentina Tanaka
